svg.title: Recorded mission, shown by robot
svg.desc: Three panels use the same final gateway snapshot from 5 October 2026. Occupancy cells, beacon positions, event vectors and retained robot trails are taken from that snapshot, rather than the current world. Retained trails are not complete trajectories.
